items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: They always come where I was. And I'd go somewhere and I'd look up and the first thing I'd see would be him and his wife.

ctx.x: The Hot Jazz, and I got a thing for that, an award.
Oh you did. Was that from Hugues Panassie, The Hot Club of France.
Yeah and you know Mr. Panassie said one time, when ever I come over there he and his wife . .
